VISITOR GUIDE

How to visit the exhibition

You can walk through the gallery on any computer, tablet or phone—and every artwork has a full-text description for screen readers.

STEP 01 · CONTROLS

On a computer or laptop

Click Load the 3D gallery above. Use your arrow keys (or click on the floor footsteps) to walk from room to room. Click any framed postcard or artwork on the wall to read the learner’s story.

STEP 02 · PHONE & TABLET

On a mobile phone

For the best view on a small screen, use the Open in a new tab link or press the Guided Tour play button inside the viewer to glide automatically through the Bonn, Madeira and Eskişehir rooms.

STEP 03 · IN PERSON

Visit the physical exhibitions

Between October 2027 and January 2028, each partner city also hosts a free three-week physical exhibition at local community venues. Check the Events page for opening hours.
